In the time of the [[Ancients]] (~ <small>IY</small> -300,000), a large [[gas giant]] named [[Fyutinyu (star)|Fyutinyu]], orbited in the [[habitable zone]] of the star [[Kneng (star)|Kneng]], the primary of the [[Lair (world)|Lair system]], and possessed eight moons of significance named, Ossobro, [[Lair (world)|Rilath]], Ursoyr, Alpdris, Duadbi, Brudeod, Ubayayl, and Efosursi. After the destruction of the local [[Draysaskin|Draysask]] named [[Esoth]] during the Ancient's War, [[Yaskoydray]] created an artificial [[pocket universe]] and rotated [[Fyutinyu (star)|Fyutinyu]] and seven of its eight moons out of normal space into it, leaving behind only [[Lair (world)|Rilath]] in normal space in [[Fyutinyu (star)|Fyutinyu]]'s former orbit. The large [[gas giant]] was subsequently artificially ignited by the introduction of significant mass and other elements to its core and lower atmosphere and became the primary G5 V star [[Fyutinyu (star)|Fyutinyu]] of the pocket universe system. 
  

== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Fyutinyu''' is a solitary star. Its age is estimated at no more than [[Ancient|300,000 years]].
* It is an artificial creation.
* It is a yellow main sequence.

{{MonostellarSystem
|name            = Fyutinyu
|primary         = G5 V
|PrimaryName     = Fyutinyu
|PrimaryNotes    = Fyutinyu is an artificially ignited star; its characteristics do not actually match the listed data for a standard star on the main-sequence
}}

[[Fyutinyu (star)|Fyutinyu]] is a former large [[gas giant]] that has been artificially ignited to form a star whose luminosity and spectrum closely matches that of [[Kneng (star)|Kneng]], the primary star of the [[Lair (world)|Lair system]]. It is currently orbited by seven bodies: seven of the former eight (artificially placed, rearranged, and terraformed) moons of the [[gas giant]]. Their orbital positions and distances have been rearranged to form a [[Rosette World|rosette]] around the artificial star. Each orbits the primary at a distance of [[Astronomical Unit|0.7 AU]].  

=== System Data ===
The worlds of [[Lair (system)|the system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* x7 [[world|rocky worlds]].

[[File:Chart Lair Fyutinyu System Basic.png|300 px]]

=== Fyutinyu Pocket Universe ===
The ''Fyutinyu'' [[pocket universe]] is linked to the primary universe through a number of [[portal]]s located on and around [[Lair (world)|Lair]], including a portal on each of [[Lair (world)|Lair's]] moonlets ''Errgh'' and ''Sanko''.  There are several dormant [[portal]]s scattered about the southern polar ''Gaksadudha continent'' and other remote locations on the surface of [[Lair (world)|Lair]].

[[TravellerMap]] <small>([[T5SS]])</small>: <br> [https://travellermap.com/?options=58367&x=-35.94&y=118&scale=128]

The entire [[pocket universe]] is approximately [[Astronomical Unit|5 AU across]]: travelling directly away from Fyutinyu in a straight line will result in arriving back at the star.
* Light from the star can never escape and fills the universe: everywhere is bathed with a soft, diffuse, constant glow.

== History & Background ([[Dossier]]) ==
In the time of the [[Ancients]], the [[Draysaskin|draysask]] ''[[Esoth]]'', one of [[Yaskoydray|Yaskoydray's]] 420 descendants (collectively known as the [[Draysaskin]]) had been assigned the task of modifying [[Terra|Terran]] canine stock to be uplifted into a sentient servitor race.  
* [[Esoth]] worked on his project of modifying the canids in the system centered on the star [[Lair (system)|Kneng]]. His base was located on a moon known as ''Ossobro'', which orbited a large [[gas giant]] named ''Fyutinyu'' that lay within [[Kneng (star)|Kneng's]] [[habitable zone]]. [[Esoth]]'s servants had terraformed the various moons of the [[gas giant]] (some of which had been moved from other locations in the [[Lair (system)|Kneng system]]) to resemble specific environments found throughout [[Charted Space]].
* One of these moons, named ''[[Lair (world)|Rilath]]'' (today called ''[[Lair (world)|Lair]]''), was modified to broadly resemble [[Terra]], and was initially home to several small groups of transplanted hominids, including Neanderthals and Homo Sapiens. It later also became the home of the early proto-[[Vargr]].

After the [[Final War]] and the elimination of [[Esoth]], [[Yaskoydray]] rotated Fyutinyu and its moons, save [[Lair (world)|Rilath]] alone, into a [[pocket universe]]. The [[gas giant]] was transformed [[Fyutinyu (star)|into a star]] and its moons were placed around it as a [[Rosette World|rosette]].
* [[Lair (world)|Rilath]] was left in the former orbit of [[Fyutinyu (star)|Fyutinyu]]. It was given [[Natural Satellite|small moons]] of its own as orbital companions: [[Lair (world)|Rilath]] became the [[homeworld]] of the [[Vargr]] race and is today known as [[Lair (world)|Lair]].  

An [[android]] named ''Ihdren-Gzal'' was constructed to oversee the equipment and resources of the Fyutinyu system from his base on Ossobro, and to observe the [[Vargr]] until the return of [[Yaskoydray]].
* As the [[Vargr]] expanded into space, Ihdren-Gzal continued his observations and administration from within the [[Pocket Universe]].
* Ihdren-Gzal constructed [[Psionics|psionically-capable]] ''Vargr-form'' [[android]]s to travel into the [[Vargr Extents|Extents]] and secretly observe the [[Vargr]] and their activities.
